task.title: L10.0 architecture, dependency and incremental-value gate: record the NO-GO results and file the locator defects it found
task.objective: Tracker bookkeeping for the executed L10.0 gate. Append the L10.0 outcome to awkit-djnl.18 (locator integration NO-GO and DOM normalization NO-GO under the pre-registered rule, evidence docs/plans/ai-upgrade-v5/evidence/L10.0-dom-intelligence-gate-2026-09-30.md); awkit-djnl.18 stays OPEN because closing or descoping L10 is the owner's decision. File one OPEN bug, not under the Phase L epic, for the pre-existing LocatorFactory wrong-element behaviors the benchmark exposed (viewport tiebreak on a same-label decoy, unguarded positional alternatives after a list re-sort, local recovery accepting a same-label element in another region, multi-second recovery failure path), with a discovered-from edge on awkit-djnl.18. Refresh .beads/issues.jsonl with bd export -o. The benchmark, verifier, evidence and docs are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits. No product code changes.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.18 stays OPEN with an appended L10.0 note stating both NO-GO gates and the evidence path; one new OPEN bug records the four locator findings with a discovered-from edge on awkit-djnl.18 and no parent-child link to the Phase L epic.
.beads/issues.jsonl is refreshed with bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl, and verify:roadmap-dashboard passes with Sources agree after its pins move to measured values.

evidence.command: bd show awkit-djnl.18 and bd show of the new bug
evidence.observed: bd update awkit-djnl.18 --append-notes recorded both NO-GO gates, the evidence path and that the issue stays OPEN for the owner decision. bd create returned awkit-epbe (P2 bug, OPEN, labels locator/runner, no parent). bd dep add printed 'awkit-epbe depends on awkit-djnl.18 (discovered-from)', and bd show awkit-epbe lists it under DISCOVERED FROM. No other issue changed status.
Printed 'Exported 331 issues to .beads/issues.jsonl'. bd stats: Total 331, Open 22, In Progress 0, dependency-Blocked 13, Closed 307, Ready 9.

A measuring run failed exactly the three tracker pins (got 331 issues, 24 outstanding / 307 closed, 196 edges), 174/177. After the pins moved to those values and the docs were updated, the final-state run printed 177/177 including 'no cycles in the real data', both narrative tallies agreeing at 65/2/0 and 'the Overview banner reads "Sources agree"'.

completion.qa_basis: Tracker changes inspected with bd show and bd stats; final state passed verify:roadmap-dashboard 177/177 with Sources agree. The L10.0 gate itself is proven by verify:dom-intelligence-gate 27/0 (mutations 3 of 4 caught, the false-GO report mutation NOT RUN because the permission classifier denied it), npm run build, typecheck:scripts, verify:verifier-classification (296), verify:blueprint-recovery 56/56, verify:blueprint-recovery-browser 24/0 and verify:locator-guard 35/0.
completion.qa_known_limitations: The benchmark, verifier, evidence and docs are ordinary unleased direct-loop edits outside this contract's project-state routing, as in earlier registrations. The Scrapling side needs the dev venv (7 pinned wheels downloaded on the owner's approval into gitignored .cache/). Timings vary run to run on this machine and are reported as ranges. verify:mock-site NOT RUN: no mock-site page changed. awkit-djnl.18 stays open by design.
